Daytime admission is complimentary for children under 12 years of age. Two-day and three-day admission tickets must be used on consecutive days. Residents must present a valid residency card issued for at least one year to qualify for the discounted admission fee of JOD 10. Daytime admission tickets and the Jordan Pass do not include admission to Petra by Night. A separate ticket must be purchased to attend the event. Jordan Pass holders wishing to access the Back Trail must present their Jordan Pass at the Ticket Office for verification. A valid daytime admission ticket is required to attend Petra by Night. Golf carts are available upon arrival and do not require advance booking. Return journeys may be scheduled when purchasing the service. Payments can be made in cash in Jordanian dinars or by Visa card. Admission to Petra by Night is complimentary for children under 10 years of age. One-way 4×4 transfers from the Cultural Village to the Monastery Trail are available daily from 7:30 AM to 3:00 PM at a fee of JOD 5 per person. Golf cart services are available daily from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Golf cart services are available during Petra by Night for elderly visitors and people with disabilities. Visitors holding tickets priced at JOD 50 or JOD 30 may extend their visit by paying an additional fee of JOD 5. This service is available exclusively at the Visitor Center. © 2024 PDTRA.
